name: 09-dawn-ramp-20260814
description: The full cam-L dawn: both pipelines in a long exponential descent. Probes down the ramp read day-pipeline gains in the incident's own sequence (railed -> ~5600 -> ~3300 -> dead-zone ~1500), the last landing ambiguous. Pre-fix that dead-zone landing was reverted 5 minutes later despite a 36-41% fall since the reading that armed the deadline; the revert latched the ratchet at 315 (bar 189, under the 256 floor - brightening path dead) with the backoff at x4, next reconfirm 4h out: IR-mode video in broad daylight until a manual restart. Post-fix (19dcd74) the still-brightening deadline extension re-anchors down the ramp until the reading crosses the day threshold and day confirms - no revert, strictly fewer clicks. Restart-equivalence bound: one reconfirm interval (3600), the invariant the design notes state; the pre-fix build holds wrong-mode for over 4700s here and fails it. RESTATED 2026-08-17: the log line naming the day-pipeline gain became 'probe confirmed day: exposure'. The incident's actual mechanism - an ambiguous dead-zone landing being reverted mid-descent, latching a ratchet below the sensor floor with the backoff already at x4 - has no counterpart: a probe verdict is binary against day_gain, there is no dead-zone outcome to revert, and there is no backoff to latch. RE-BASELINED 2026-08-17, and the number is the point. This scenario feeds NO integration-time curve, so it exercises the degraded gain-only path where the exposure index collapses back to bare total_gain - and its night curve floors at 260, i.e. it asserts a sensor pinned at the [24.8] gain floor from t~7500 onward. A pinned sensor cannot show any further brightening, so path C is structurally exhausted exactly when dawn completes and the heartbeat is the only recourse left: recovery lands one heartbeat_s after the last probe (~2970s here), not 600s. That is the honest bound of the degraded path, and heartbeat_s is the operator's knob for it. Scenario 15 is the same dawn WITH the integration-time channel the redesign added, and recovers promptly - which is what the exposure index is for. Keeping both is the point: 09 documents what the machine can do when the metric is blind, 15 documents what it does when it is not.
